test_class_inheritance: test the pybind11 class_ module inheritance hierarchy with Pet, Rabbit, Dog, and Hamster subclasses
test_class_automatic_upcasting: test automatic upcasting of derived class instances back to base class types in pybind11 bindings
test_class_isinstance: test pybind11 isinstance checks across mixed Python tuples, dicts, and bound C++ Pet and Dog objects
test_class_docstrings: test that pybind11-generated docstrings include correct signatures, __qualname__, and module names for classes and methods
test_class_operator_new_delete: test that class-specific operator new and delete functions are invoked during object construction and destruction
